title: Cavity collapse and kinetic energy concentration in three-dimensional free-boundary Euler flow
summary: We construct smooth axisymmetric solutions of the three-dimensional incompressible free-boundary Euler equations in bounded domains for which a tubular cavity collapses onto a circle at a finite time $T$. The velocity has a single-valued potential, and the construction applies without surface tension and with any fixed positive surface tension. Both boundary components remain embedded and disjoint before collapse, while the outer boundary converges smoothly.
